newsitem.title: CANADA: Vermilion raises C$45 million in warrants.
newsitem.headline: Vermilion raises C$45 million in warrants.

text.p: Vermilion Resources Ltd said on Monday it will issue 10 million special warrants at C$4.50 each, for a total of C$45 million.
The issue is a bought deal with Nesbitt Burns, FirstEnergy Capital Corp and Griffiths McBurney, Vermilion said.
Each special warrant entitles the holder to receive one common share of Vermilion at no additional cost. The financing is scheduled to close January 15.
Vermilion said it will use the proceeds to purchase certain oil and gas assets in France.
